description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers designing or auditing an engineering interview loop, including a model in the screening step (EN + DE). Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours: comp bands (comp-banding), new-hire onboarding (onboarding-program), performance feedback (perf-feedback-craft), org structure (org-design), and writing a CV.

queries.q: design our interview loop for senior backend engineers
audit our hiring bar, too many false positives
take-home or live coding for this role?
can we use an LLM to screen the CVs for this position?
wie sollten wir unseren Bewerbungsprozess für Entwickler aufbauen
set salary bands for our engineering levels
plan the first 30 days for a new hire
help me write a difficult performance review
should we split the platform team into two squads
rewrite my CV so it gets past applicant tracking systems
queries.note: a candidate-side CV rewrite, not loop design (career pack not adopted)
